tools.engine: the engine rerun as latexmk would: BibTeX/Biber/makeindex on changed input, again while the build files change
tools.satex: satex compile --system satex: own fixpoint, preamble format, no pass when nothing read changed; explains the log, with the analysis where a message needs it
tools.satex-build: satex compile --system satex, compile.explain=false: the PDF only
tools.satex-warm: satex-build with compile.warm=true: a pdfTeX waits on its format for the next build

scenarios.cold: fresh copy, no build files; OS file cache, font cache and satex package caches primed
scenarios.warm: rebuild with nothing changed, after a full build
scenarios.edit: rebuild after one body word changed, after a full build
